recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. Reintroducing a separate encounter child would conflict with later accepted R5/R6 decisions; future concerns about the broader context element should be handled under the later DocumentReference context trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-6346 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 request to add a direct Encounter relationship to DocumentReference instead of relying on unclear catch-all related/reference modeling.
initial_application: The Jira comments identify svn revision 6188, and git-svn commit e3000793223d9ec9b379c432b7f80cddbbd66087 ('#6346 - add DocumentReference.encounter') added DocumentReference.context.encounter as Reference(Encounter) plus an Encounter example.
additional_context: Later published/applied work intentionally changed the shape: FHIR-29801 renamed the encounter property to DocumentReference.context and added Appointment/EpisodeOfCare while retaining Encounter, and FHIR-54170 updated the context definition for that broader target set.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/fhir.ini keeps DocumentReference active and source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml defines DocumentReference.context as 0..* Reference(Appointment, Encounter, EpisodeOfCare), with supporting search parameter and notes steering encounter context to .context rather than .related.
